name: AWS ELB
description: Protects against destructive AWS Elastic Load Balancing (ELB/ALB/NLB) \ operations like deleting load balancers, target groups, or deregistering \ targets from live traffic.

destructive_patterns.name: elbv2-delete-load-balancer
destructive_patterns.description: aws elbv2 delete-load-balancer permanently deletes the load balancer.

destructive_patterns.name: elbv2-delete-target-group
destructive_patterns.description: aws elbv2 delete-target-group permanently deletes the target group.

destructive_patterns.name: elbv2-deregister-targets
destructive_patterns.description: aws elbv2 deregister-targets removes targets from the load balancer, impacting live traffic.

destructive_patterns.name: elbv2-delete-listener
destructive_patterns.description: aws elbv2 delete-listener deletes a listener, potentially breaking traffic routing.

destructive_patterns.name: elbv2-delete-rule
destructive_patterns.description: aws elbv2 delete-rule deletes a listener rule, potentially breaking routing.

destructive_patterns.name: elb-delete-load-balancer
destructive_patterns.description: aws elb delete-load-balancer permanently deletes the classic load balancer.

destructive_patterns.name: elb-deregister-instances
destructive_patterns.description: aws elb deregister-instances-from-load-balancer removes instances from the load balancer, impacting live traffic.
